items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: Peter Bocard was a good violin player.

ctx.x: Did you like to play with the violin?

I didn't care about violin. Well? I don't like playing. I didn't care too much about violin. But they were the boss all the time. A lot of the violin players used to be leaders. They were leaders. They used to run the outfit. They run the outfit. Like Eugene Deeson. No, not Eugene Deeson. Paul Dominguez, he was a good violin player. He was a good violin player. Peter Bocard was a good violin player. And there's other fellow, I can't tell his name. Ted Dominguez? Ted Dominguez, he was a good violin player.…
How about a horse? Did you ever see a horse with his violin?
